title: Hazaar Khwahishein Aisi
lines: Hazaar khwahishein aisi ke har khwahish pe dam nikle
Bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle
Na main jaanaa jun-ko na woh jaane mast-e-daraa
Ke kis ka kaun hai tu tera kaun hai tera
Mohsin se dil ne waista kiya hai jo har roz
Bakhshish ke badle dard-e-dil ka sauda karte hain
meaning: A thousand desires each worth dying for. Many wishes were fulfilled yet still too few.

title: Dil-e-Nadan Tujhe Hua Kya Hai
lines: Dil-e-nadan tujhe hua kya hai
Aakhir is dard ki dawa kya hai
Aah ko chahiye ek umr asar hone tak
Kaun jeeta hai teri zulf ke sar hone tak
meaning: O innocent heart what has happened? A sigh needs a lifetime to take effect.

title: Ishq Mujhko Nahin Sahi
lines: Ishq mujhko nahin sahi woh jahaan sahi
Jung-e-ishq sahi jang-e-jaan sahi
Woh jo shak ho to khud ko jala de sahi
Ishq pe koi zarf ka imtihaan sahi
meaning: If love is not for me then the world is. If it means war of love so be it.

title: Ye Na Thi Hamari Qismat
lines: Ye na thi hamari qismat ke wisaal-e-yaar hota
Agar aur jeete rehte yahi intezaar hota
Teri naazuki se jaana ke bande bayabaan hain
Teri galiyon ke hawaon ke bhi diwaar hain
meaning: It was not my fate to meet the beloved. Had I lived longer this wait would continue.

title: Koi Ummeed Bar Nahin Aati
lines: Koi ummeed bar nahin aati
Koi soorat nazar nahin aati
Maut ka ek din muayyan hai
Neend kyon raat bhar nahin aati
Aage aati thi haal-e-dil pe hansi
Ab hai unki yaad kuch khar khar aati
meaning: No hope remains. No way out is visible. Death is certain one day.

title: Bazeecha-e-Atfaal Hai Duniya
lines: Bazeecha-e-atfaal hai duniya mere aage
Hota hai shab-o-roz tamasha mere aage
meaning: The world is a playground before me. Night and day a spectacle unfolds.

title: Kuch To Majbooriyan Rahi Hongi
lines: Kuch to majbooriyan rahi hongi
Yun koi bewafa nahin hota
meaning: There must have been some compulsion. No one is unfaithful without reason.

title: Muddat Hui Hai Yaar Ko Mehman
lines: Muddat hui hai yaar ko mehman kiye hue
Dil mein kuch baat hai jo zubaan aati nahi
meaning: It has been long since I hosted my beloved. Something in the heart the tongue cannot speak.

title: Ye Woh Sorat Hai Ki Hum Unke
lines: Ye woh sorat hai ki hum unke
Siwa kuch yaad nahin aata
meaning: This is the state where nothing but you comes to my mind.

title: Husn Aur Ishq Dono Uska
lines: Husn aur ishq dono uska haseen hain
Dard-e-dil uska hai ya seen hain
meaning: Beauty and love both belong to that person. Is it the heart or the chest?

title: Lab Pe Aati Hai Dua
lines: Lab pe aati hai dua ban ke tamanna meri
Zindagi sham a ki soorat ho Khudaya meri
Door duniya ka mere dam se andhera ho jaaye
Har jagah mere chamakne se ujala ho jaaye
Ho meri ummat ke dil mein itna chaah ki har qadam
Mere josh-e-dil se har qadam pe ujaala ho jaaye
meaning: A prayer comes to my lips: may my life be like a candle light. May darkness be removed by my presence.

title: Sitaron Se Aage Jahaan Aur Bhi
lines: Sitaron se aage jahaan aur bhi hain
Abhi ishq ke imtihaan aur bhi hain
Tu shaheen hai parwaz hai kaam tera
Tere saamne aasman aur bhi hain
meaning: Beyond the stars there are worlds still more. Tests of love still await. You are an eagle.

title: Shikwa Jawab-e-Shikwa
lines: Shikwa kya hai teri rehmat se gila kya hai
Kyun kar karun teri ataon ka sabab pukaar
meaning: What is my complaint against your mercy? Why should I complain about your gifts?

title: Khudi Ka Sir-e-Nihan
lines: Khudi ka sir-e-nihan la ilaha illallah
Khudi hai tegh safa sar apna khuda hai
meaning: The secret of selfhood is there is no god but God. The self is a polished sword.

title: Taraqqi Ka Raaz
lines: Taraqqi ka raaz hai yehi hai jahan mein
Jo apni fitrat ki rawani mein chalta hai
meaning: The secret of progress is to flow with your own nature.

title: Qaum Ka MATLAB
lines: Qaum ka matlab hai apni qoumat ki taameer
Silsila-e-ummat aur silsila-e-taakheer
meaning: The purpose of a nation is the building of its own dignity.

title: Nigah-e-Faqr Mein Shan-e-Khuda
lines: Nigah-e-faqr mein shan-e-khuda kya hai
Woh dust-e-aashiqan ki tawheen kya hai
meaning: In the gaze of the poor lies the glory of God.

title: Saqi-e-Ard-e-Najaf
lines: Saqi-e-ard-e-Najaf de de shaam-e-Mustafa
Ya faza-e-Madina kar de mujh ko justa-o-gasta
meaning: O cupbearer of Najaf grant me the evening of the Prophet.

title: Mujh Se Pehli Si Mohabbat
lines: Mujh se pehli si mohabbat mere mehboob na maang
Maine samjha tha ke tu hai to darakhshaan hoga
Meri wafaon ka rang aur tanha main kya hoga
Woh jo hum mein tum mein qaraar tha tum yaad karo
meaning: Do not ask me for that old love again. I thought with you everything would shine.

title: Aur Bhi Dukh Hain Zamane Mein
lines: Aur bhi dukh hain zamane mein mohabbat ke siva
Rahaten aur bhi rahish ki raht ke siva
meaning: There are other sorrows in the world besides love.

title: Gulon Mein Rang Bhare
lines: Gulon mein rang bhare baad-e-naubahar chale
Chale bhi aao ke gulshan ka karobar chale
meaning: Let the flowers be filled with color let the spring breeze come.

title: Hum Dekhenge
lines: Hum dekhenge Laazim hai ke hum bhi dekhenge
Wo din ke jiska waada hai
meaning: We shall see. It is inevitable that we shall see. That day which has been promised.

title: Raat Yoon Dil Mein Teri
lines: Raat yoon dil mein teri khoi hui yaad aayi
Jaise woh jaati hai behsi ke aakhri saans aayi
meaning: The night brought back your lost memory. Like the last breath of consciousness.

title: Intezar Zindagi Ka
lines: Intezar zindagi ka hai tera intezaar
Tu aaye na aaye yeh alag sawaal hai
meaning: The waiting of life is waiting for you.

title: Dono Jahan Teri Muhabbat Mein Haar Ke
lines: Dono jahan teri muhabbat mein haar ke
Woh ja raha hai koi keh raha hai intezaar kar
meaning: Having lost both worlds in your love. Someone is going saying wait.

title: Maaon Se Mere Kahe Do
lines: Maaon se mere kahe do ki aae din sajti hun
Baith ke takiya karti hun rasta takti hun
meaning: Tell my mothers that I adorn myself everyday. I sit watching the door.

title: Yeh Jahan Chaar Din Ka
lines: Yeh jahan chaar din ka mela hai
Aur aana bhi hai jaana bhi hai
meaning: This world is a fair of four days. One must come and must go.

title: Aye Ishq Ab Kya Bataayein
lines: Aye ishq ab kya bataayein
Dil kya cheez hai deewangi kya hai
meaning: O love what shall I tell now. What is the heart what is this madness.

title: Khuda Ke Vaaste Zara Dekh Ke Chal
lines: Khuda ke vaaste zara dekh ke chal
Kisi ke pairon mein zakhm na de de
meaning: For Gods sake look where you are going. Be careful not to wound someone.

title: Dil Mein Tere Khamoshiyan
lines: Dil mein tere khamoshiyan chhupi hain
Dil se tere javaab aate nahi
meaning: Your silences are hidden in the heart. Answers do not come.

title: Mohabbat Mein Nahin Hai Farq
lines: Mohabbat mein nahin hai farq jeene aur marne ka
Usi ko dekh kar jeete hain jis kaafir pe dam nikle
meaning: In love there is no difference between living and dying.

title: Is Umar Ko Bhi Mil Jaye Koi
lines: Is umar ko bhi mil jaye koi
Jo khud bhi roye aur mujh ko bhi rulaye
meaning: May someone come who cries herself and makes me cry too.

title: Bhula Do Mujhko
lines: Bhula do mujhko agar yaad na aata
Yaad karta hun to yaad bahut aata
meaning: Forget me if I do not remember. When I do remember I remember a lot.

title: Ranjish Hi Sahi
lines: Ranjish hi sahi dil hi dukhaane ke liye aa
Aa phir se mujhe chhod ke jaane ke liye aa
Ek umr se hoon laal-e-yar mein jalte hue
Na teri shan na tera ilzaam ke liye aa
meaning: Come even if to resent me to break my heart. Come once more even if just to leave me again.

title: Ab Ke Hum Bichde To Shayad
lines: Ab ke hum bichde to shayad kabhi khwaabon mein milein
Jis tarah sookhe hue phool kitaabon mein milein
meaning: If we part now perhaps we will meet in dreams. Like dried flowers found in books.

title: Tum Meri Zindagi Ka Hissa Ho
lines: Tum meri zindagi ka hissa ho kya ghazal
Mera dil teri aankhon se jhoothi khabar sunata hai
meaning: You are a part of my life. My heart delivers false news from your eyes.

title: Sar-e-Raah Tere Naam Likha
lines: Sar-e-raah tere naam likha
Raste ne poochha kaun ho tum
meaning: I wrote your name at the crossroads. The road asked who are you.

title: Mehfil Se Uthne Waalon Ko
lines: Mehfil se uthne waalon ko kya kahen
Jo baithe the to maza aa gaya tha
meaning: What shall we say to those who left the gathering. When they sat it was delightful.

title: Zindagi Mein Koi
lines: Zindagi mein koi kabhi kisi se milta hi nahi
Ye sab riwayat hai purani ye kahani nahi
meaning: In life no one ever truly meets anyone. This is an old tradition not a new story.

title: Zakhm-e-Dil
lines: Zakhm-e-dil ka marham dhoondta phirta hun
Apni aankhon mein teri aankhein dhoondta phirta hun
meaning: I wander searching for a balm for the wound of my heart. I search for your eyes in my own eyes.

title: Mere Khutut Ki Tareekh
lines: Mere khutut ki tareekh mein ek naam hai tera
Dard-e-dil ki dastakhat mein ek naam hai tera
meaning: In the history of my letters there is only your name. In the signature of heartache there is your name.

title: Kuch To Majbooriyan
lines: Kuch to majbooriyan rahi hongi
Yun koi bewafa nahin hota
meaning: There must have been some compulsion. No one is unfaithful without reason.

title: Mah-e-Tamam
lines: Mah-e-tamam guzra hua chand saal ke baad
Phir se meri zindagi mein aane wala hai koi
meaning: After many years the full moon is about to enter my life again.

title: Samundar Kisi Ke
lines: Samundar kisi ke intezaar mein baitha hai
Khwab kisi ke aankhon mein abhi baaki hain
meaning: The ocean sits waiting for someone. Dreams still remain in someone's eyes.

title: Aaj Mujhe Dard-e-Dil Ka
lines: Aaj mujhe dard-e-dil ka maza aa gaya
Teri yaad ne mujhe rula ke dekha
meaning: Today I enjoyed the pain of my heart. Your memory tried making me cry.

title: Kisi Ko Usse Bhi Dard
lines: Kisi ko usse bhi dard-e-dil ka ilzaam na do
Jo kuch na kare wo bhi kitna kuch karta hai
meaning: Do not blame someone for heartache. Even one who does nothing does so much.

title: Deewangi Meri Tujhko Bhi Pata Hai
lines: Deewangi meri tujhko bhi pata hai
Main kya kya sochta hun ye bhi tujhe maloom hai
meaning: You know my madness. You know what all I think.

title: Tum Mujhe Kyun Nahi Milte
lines: Tum mujhe kyun nahi milte
Hai kya raaz tumhari zindagi ka
meaning: Why do I not find you. What is the secret of your life.

title: Jine Ki Arzoo Thi
lines: Jine ki arzoo thi magar aa gayi maut
Har kisi ki qismat mein yeh nahi hota
meaning: I wished to live but death arrived. This does not happen to everyone.

title: Mujhe Hi Dekhte Raho
lines: Mujhe hi dekhte raho raat din tum
Mujhe hi dekho ya mujhe chhod do
meaning: Keep looking at me day and night. Either keep looking or let me go.

title: Kuch Is Tarah Se
lines: Kuch is tarah se tune mujhe nazar-andaz kiya
Ke main apni hi nazar mein jo hoon wo bhi ban gaya
meaning: You ignored me in such a way that I lost even what I was in my own eyes.

title: Ek Ajnabi Haseena Se
lines: Ek ajnabi haseena se yun mera dil laga
Ke zindagi ki tamanna phir kyun kar bachi
meaning: My heart fell for a stranger beauty. How did the desire to live then survive.

title: The Guest House
lines: This being human is a guest house.
Every morning a new arrival.
A joy, a depression, a meanness,
some momentary awareness comes
as an unexpected visitor.
Welcome and entertain them all!
Even if they are a crowd of sorrows,
who violently sweep your house
empty of its furniture,
still, treat each guest honorably.
He may be clearing you out
for some new delight.
meaning: Rumi teaches us to welcome every experience as a guest bringing gifts of growth.

title: Out Beyond Ideas
lines: Out beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing,
there is a field. I'll meet you there.
When the soul lies down in that grass,
the world is too full to talk about.
Ideas, language, even the phrase each other
doesn't make any sense.
meaning: Rumi invites us beyond all labels into a space of pure connection.

title: Come Come Whoever You Are
lines: Come, come, whoever you are.
Wanderer, worshiper, lover of leaving.
It doesn't matter.
Ours is not a caravan of despair.
Come, even if you have broken your vows a thousand times.
Come, yet again, come, come.
meaning: An invitation to all seekers regardless of their past. Come as you are.

title: Only Breath
lines: Not Christian or Jew or Muslim, not Hindu
Buddhist, sufi, or zen. Not from any religion
or cultural system.
I am not from the East or the West,
not out of the ocean or up from the ground,
not natural or ethereal, not composed
of elements at all.
I belong to the Beloved, have seen the two worlds as one
and that one call to and know,
first, last, outer, inner, only that
breath breathing human being.
meaning: Rumi transcends all boundaries in this poem of unity.

title: The Wound Is The Place
lines: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
Do not feel lonely, the entire universe is inside you.
meaning: Our wounds become doorways for light. We carry the whole universe within.

title: Let Yourself Be Silently Drawn
lines: Let yourself be silently drawn
by the strange pull of what you really love.
It will not lead you astray.
meaning: Trust the pull of your true calling. It knows the way.

title: The Art of Loving
lines: Love is the water of life.
Drink it down, let it drown you.
The minute I heard my first love story
I started looking for you, not knowing
how blind that was.
Lovers don't finally meet somewhere.
They're in each other all along.
meaning: Love is life's essential water. We were always already together.

title: A Great Wagon
lines: Out beyond wrongdoing and rightdoing there is a field. I will meet you there.
When the soul lies down in that grass the world is too full to talk about.
Ideas, language, even the phrase each other does not make any sense.
meaning: A poem about transcending dualities and finding unity.

title: The Road Not Taken
lines: Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,
And sorry I could not travel both
And be one traveler, long I stood
And looked down one as far as I could
To where it bent in the undergrowth;
I took the one less traveled by,
And that has made all the difference.
meaning: Frost reflects on the choices we make in life and how they define our journey.

title: Stopping By Woods
lines: Whose woods these are I think I know.
His house is in the village though;
He will not see me stopping here
To watch his woods fill up with snow.
But I have promises to keep,
And miles to go before I sleep,
And miles to go before I sleep.
meaning: A meditation on duty and the seductive pull of rest and nature.

title: Nothing Gold Can Stay
lines: Nature's first green is gold,
Her hardest hue to hold.
Her early leaf's a flower;
But only so an hour.
Then leaf subsides to leaf.
So Eden sank to grief,
So dawn goes down to day.
Nothing gold can stay.
meaning: The fleeting nature of beauty and innocence.

title: Fire and Ice
lines: Some say the world will end in fire,
Some say in ice.
From what I've tasted of desire
I hold with those who favor fire.
But if it had to perish twice,
I think I know enough of hate
To say that for destruction ice
Is also great
And would suffice.
meaning: Desire and hate as forces of destruction.

title: Birches
lines: When I see birches bend to left and right
Across the lines of straighter darker trees,
I like to think some boy's been swinging them.
But swinging doesn't bend them down to stay.
Ice-storms do that.
I'd like to get away from earth awhile
And then come back to it and begin over.
meaning: The desire to escape and return renewed.

title: Acquainted With The Night
lines: I have been one acquainted with the night.
I have walked out in rain -- and back in rain.
I have outwalked the furthest city light.
I have looked down the saddest city lane.
I have passed by the watchman on his beat
And dropped my eyes, unwilling to explain.
meaning: A profound poem about loneliness and alienation.

title: Hope Is The Thing With Feathers
lines: Hope is the thing with feathers -
That perches in the soul -
And sings the tune without the words -
And never stops - at all -
And sweetest - in the Gale - is heard -
And sore must be the storm -
That could abash the little Bird
That kept so many warm -
meaning: Hope as a bird that sings eternally within us, resilient against storms.

title: Because I Could Not Stop For Death
lines: Because I could not stop for Death -
He kindly stopped for me -
The Carriage held but just Ourselves -
And Immortality.
We slowly drove - He knew no haste
And I had put away
My labor and my leisure too,
For His Civility -
meaning: Death as a courteous gentleman caller taking us on a journey.

title: I Taste A Liquor Never Brewed
lines: I taste a liquor never brewed -
From Tankards scooped in Pearl -
Not all the Vintners of the Summer
Could intoxicate me so -
Inebriate of Air - am I -
And Debauchee of Dew -
Reeling - through endless summer days -
From inns of Molten Blue -
meaning: Intoxication with nature's beauty, surpassing any earthly drink.

title: If I Can Stop One Heart From Breaking
lines: If I can stop one heart from breaking,
I shall not live in vain;
If I can ease one life the aching,
Or help one robin to his nest again,
I shall not live in vain.
meaning: A life of purpose through simple acts of kindness.

title: There Is No Frigate Like A Book
lines: There is no Frigate like a Book
To take us Lands away,
Nor any Coursers like a Page
Of prancing Poetry -
meaning: Books as vessels that carry us to distant lands.

title: Sonnet 18 - Shall I Compare Thee
lines: Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?
Thou art more lovely and more temperate.
Rough winds do shake the darling buds of May,
And summer's lease hath all too short a date.
So long as men can breathe, or eyes can see,
So long lives this, and this gives life to thee.
meaning: The beloved outlasts even summer through the immortality of verse.

title: Sonnet 116 - Let Me Not
lines: Let me not to the marriage of true minds
Admit impediments. Love is not love
Which alters when it alteration finds,
Or bends with the remover to remove.
If this be error and upon me proved,
I never writ, nor no man ever loved.
meaning: Love as an eternal, unchanging force beyond time.

title: Sonnet 130 - My Mistress Eyes
lines: My mistress' eyes are nothing like the sun;
Coral is far more red than her lips' red;
If snow be white, why then her breasts are dun;
If hairs be wires, black wires grow on her head.
And yet, by heaven, I think my love as rare
As any she belied with false compare.
meaning: Real love sees beauty beyond exaggerated comparisons.

title: Sonnet 29 - When In Disgrace
lines: When in disgrace with fortune and men's eyes
I all alone beweep my outcast state
And trouble deaf heaven with my bootless cries
And look upon myself and curse my fate,
Haply I think on thee, and then my state
Like to the lark at break of day arising
From sullen earth, sings hymns at heaven's gate.
meaning: Thinking of the beloved transforms despair into joy.

title: Sonnet 73 - That Time Of Year
lines: That time of year thou mayst in me behold
When yellow leaves, or none, or few, do hang
Upon those boughs which shake against the cold,
Bare ruin'd choirs, where late the sweet birds sang.
This thou perceiv'st, which makes thy love more strong,
To love that well which thou must leave ere long.
meaning: Aging and mortality deepening love's urgency.

title: Bura Jo Dekhan Main Chala
lines: Bura jo dekhan main chala bura na milya koi
Jo dil khoja apna mujhse bura na koi
meaning: I searched for evil but found none. When I looked into my heart I found no one worse than me.

title: Moko Kahan Dhundhe Re Bande
lines: Moko kahan dhundhe re bande main to tere paas mein
Na mandir mein na masjid mein na kaabe na kailaas mein
meaning: Where do you search for me O servant? I am near you.

title: Kaal Kare So Aaj Kar
lines: Kaal kare so aaj kar aaj kare so ab
Pal mein parlay hoga baaki hai kab
meaning: Do tomorrow's work today, today's work now.

title: Pahan Puje Hari Mili
lines: Pahan puje hari mili main to pujun raghuvera
Tan se ragan jari gai mo se chhuda nahin jeevera
meaning: If worshipping stones finds God then I worship Rama.

title: Dheere Se Jana Baghin Mein
lines: Dheere se jana baghin mein khar-khar gaayen charain
Ek kafan tani hai leke kya doosri kafan badlain
meaning: Walk slowly into the forest. We have one shroud.

title: Na Kar Manaya Hussain Te
lines: Na kar manaya hussain te na kar manaya ali te
Bulleh shah kis ne manaya jis ne manaya oh ali te
meaning: Do not try to appease by force. Those who appease are truly powerful.

title: Tere Ishq Nachaya
lines: Tere ishq nachaya karke thayya thayya
Pani vich kulya karkay mudda utarya
meaning: Your love made me dance standing still.

title: Bulla Ki Jaana
lines: Bulla ki jaana mein kaun
Naa maa roop naa rang naa kaaya
meaning: Who knows who I am. I follow no religion.

title: Rabb Di Laawan
lines: Rabb di laawan vich ki layi dil diyan gallan
Dil vich raaz sharaar lagaya
meaning: In Gods love what place have the whispers of the heart.

title: Kafir Kamli Wale
lines: Kafir kamli wale ne rang dekhiya
Ro ro ke sab ke oochay akkhan tik laiyan
meaning: The infidel in the blanket saw your colors.

title: The Second Coming
lines: Turning and turning in the widening gyre
The falcon cannot hear the falconer;
Things fall apart; the centre cannot hold;
Mere anarchy is loosed upon the world,
The blood-dimmed tide is loosed, and everywhere
The ceremony of innocence is drowned;
meaning: Apocalyptic vision of civilizational collapse.

title: Sailing To Byzantium
lines: That is no country for old men. The young
In one another's arms, birds in the trees,
Those dying generations - at their song,
The salmon-falls, the mackerel-crowded seas,
meaning: A plea for transcendence over the mortality of nature.

title: Easter 1916
lines: I have met them at close of day
Coming with vivid faces
From counter or desk among grey
Eighteenth-century houses,
I have passed with a nod of the head
Or polite meaningless words,
Or have lingered awhile and said
Polite meaningless words,
meaning: A meditation on the transformation of ordinary people through revolutionary sacrifice.

title: Dreams
lines: Hold fast to dreams
For if dreams die
Life is a broken-winged bird
That cannot fly.
Hold fast to dreams
For when dreams go
Life is a barren field
Frozen with snow.
meaning: Without dreams life loses its ability to soar and becomes desolate.

title: Life Is Fine
lines: I went down to the river,
I set down on the bank.
I tried to think but could not,
So I jumped in and sank.
Life is fine!
Fine as wine!
Life is fine!
meaning: Facing life challenges head-on and finding them beautiful.

title: I Too Sing America
lines: I, too, sing America.
I am the darker brother.
They send me to eat in the kitchen
When company comes,
But I laugh,
And eat well,
And grow strong.
Tomorrow,
I will be at the table
When company comes.
meaning: A powerful assertion of belonging and dignity in the face of discrimination.

title: Where The Mind Is Without Fear
lines: Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high;
Where knowledge is free;
Where the world has not been broken up into fragments
by narrow domestic walls;
Where words come out from the depth of truth;
Where tireless striving stretches its arms towards perfection;
Where the clear stream of reason has not lost its way
into the dreary desert sand of dead habit;
Into that heaven of freedom, my Father, let my country awake.
meaning: Tagore prayer for an awakened and free India.

title: Gitanjali 35
lines: Where dost thou stand behind them all, my lover,
hidden in the shadows of their successive masks?
Seeking me in dark corners they do not know that
I am with them all.
meaning: God is present everywhere even when we do not recognize.

title: The Crescent Moon
lines: The sleep that flits on baby's eyes - does anybody know where it was born?
It is faint like the yellow moonlight in a thin cloud,
It smells like a half-blown jasmine flower in the dusk.
It has a shadow that dances on the cradle leaves.
meaning: The mysterious origin of a baby sleep.

title: Hairan Hun Tere Qareeb Aane Se
lines: Hairan hun tere qareeb aane se
Ye kaisa nasha hai jo sanson mein ghula hai
meaning: I am amazed at your closeness. What intoxication has dissolved in my breath.

title: Teri Yaad Ka Dard
lines: Teri yaad ka dard hai jo sataata hai
Woh dil se nikalta nahi jo chupaaya hai
meaning: The pain of your memory torments me. That which I hid does not leave my heart.

title: Ilahi Teri Chaukhat Pe
lines: Ilahi teri chaukhat pe aakar sar jhuka diya
Jo teri raza mein hai usko apni raza bana diya
meaning: O God I came to your threshold and bowed my head. What is in your will I have made my own.
